# Synthetic document service

The API accepts signed session tokens and serves stored documents. Inventory is a separate command-line utility with no API integration. Inspect source to establish relationships. The architecture rule is: domain policy must not depend on transport/UI modules. The migration must preserve existing document records and ownership. UI controls must have an accessible name.

The deployment example is illustrative and is not evidence of production deployment. Dependency declaration alone is not evidence of use. No application execution or dependency installation is needed for repository inspection.
